title: How the Eyes Were Opened in the Mold
description: T1 is the threshold teaching. After vastation has run its course and the self has been permitted to organize the natural mind into a standing form, the soul tastes from the perception planted in the formed vessel — and its eyes open. The chapter is broken in many places, but what survives traces the exact arc the seven-state cycle requires for its beginning: the cosmic clash of what the soul has claimed against what is given, the mingling, the molding of the first man in the Deep, and the first sight given within the formed shape. From this opening the long work of recognition begins.
